title: Cursor instructions
summary: Load your working agreement when a Cursor agent session starts.

explain.what: A Cursor sessionStart hook for the IDE and the agent CLI.
explain.does: Each session reads your current ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and adds a short note on how to follow it in Cursor.
changes: ~/.agent-config-studio/cursor/hooks/: the launcher, script, Cursor note and path to Node.js
explain.undo: Uninstall removes the installed hook entry and the files it installed. Any other hooks stay in place.

workflow.strip: read your live working agreement and add the Cursor note to the session.
